desc: Parse N, M, start point, house coordinates, and movement instructions from stdin.
Simulate the M moves to compute the final position using Python ints (handles overflow beyond 32-bit).
Group horizontal segments by y and merge overlapping/adjacent inclusive x-intervals; do the same for vertical segments by x and y-intervals.
For each house, binary-search its row intervals and column intervals; count it once if found in either.
Output final X, Y, and the distinct-house count; verified on both provided samples (including the overflow sample 2).
